xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DeclarationOfUnmodifiedOpinion: Statement on impact of audit qualification
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp: The management delayed in payment to a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) in respect of some vendor financing arrangements that were contractually due on the specified payment date. Upon verification, it was noted that there was a delay in the settlement of dues payable to the said NBFC.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditQualificationsWhereTheImp: The company has affirmed that it will make any delay in the settlement of dues payable to the said NBFC.
